text:
### NCMA SGV

The goal of the NCM SGV project is to analyze website performance, audience engagement, and branch out to membership growth opportunities.

By using GA4, BigQuery, Looker Studio, and Google Search Console we are able to look into user behavior, engagement rates, and audience retention.
The analysis focused on traffic channels, landing pages, devices, and audience segments and how this contributed differently to engagement. This helped identify opportunities for website optimization and long-term audience reach.
